steps.title: EDF Reading
steps.desc: PyEDFlib reads only the required 30-second window from disk — keeps training RAM under 3 GB.

steps.title: Channel Selection
steps.desc: 19 common bipolar channels kept across all 11 patients; 4 non-universal channels dropped.

steps.title: Bandpass Filter
steps.desc: 4th-order Butterworth, 0.5–45 Hz. Removes drift and high-frequency noise.

steps.title: Resampling
steps.desc: 256 Hz → 128 Hz. Halves memory and compute while preserving 0.5–45 Hz content.

steps.title: Z-Score Normalization
steps.desc: Per-channel zero-mean, unit-variance — makes sessions and patients comparable.

steps.title: Transpose
steps.desc: (channels, time) → (time, channels) for batch-first LSTM input.

zones.desc: Normal brain activity far from seizure
25 min pre-seizure window the model learns to detect
5 min prediction horizon — alarm must fire before this
